action.objective: Complete broad depth-4 coverage of all legal moves to pick a candidate after 12...c5.
action.rationale: Opening phase, must start with full-root broad search. Black just played 12...c5, pressuring d4 and challenging the e5 knight. Legal moves include developing c1 bishop, castling e1g1, knight retreats, and bishop moves. Needs full assessment before choosing a candidate.
